summary: A see-through preview of one or more prop meshes that only one player sees, useful for showing where something will be built. It is not a prop: it has no collision, and it ends at the player's next level load or when they leave. Client scripts can draw their own with PropGhost.create(options), with no player and nothing sent to anyone.

create.summary: Shows a preview to a player in the world. A player can have up to 32.

params.options: `model`, a prop mesh, or `models`, up to 16, with matching `offsets` and `rotations`; `position`, required; `rotation`; `scale`, 0.01 to 100, a number or a per-axis Vector3; `tint`, a Color, or null for the meshes' materials; `validTint` and `invalidTint`.

create.exampleLua:
local Color, Vector3 = kcds.math.Color, kcds.math.Vector3

local barrelPreview = kcds.world.PropGhost.create(player, { model = "beer_barrel", position = player.position, tint = Color.new(0, 1, 0, 0.5) })
barrelPreview:setPose(player.position:clone():add(Vector3.new(0, 0, 2)))
create.exampleCs:
var barrelPreview = PropGhost.Create(player, new { model = "beer_barrel", position = player.Position, tint = new Color(0, 1, 0, 0.5) });
barrelPreview.SetPose(player.Position.Clone().Add(new Vector3(0, 0, 2)));

params.player: Optional: limits it to this player.

destroyAll.summary: Removes all previews, or one player's.

params.player: Optional: limits it to this player.

scale.summary: Its size: a number, or a Vector3 if scaled per axis.

setPose.summary: Moves, turns or resizes it, leaving out values unchanged.

params.scale: Optional: the new size, a number or per-axis Vector3.

setTint.summary: Changes the colour. null uses the meshes' materials.

setValid.summary: Shows the valid or invalid tint it was created with.

setHidden.summary: Hides or shows the preview without removing it.

getBounds.summary: Client only. The box its meshes occupy in the world, as { min, max }, as the game last measured it, a frame after it stands or moves. Null before its meshes stand, while hidden, and once destroyed. Always null on the server.
getBounds.exampleLua:
-- client
local box = ghost:getBounds()
if box then
  local height = box.max.z - box.min.z
  kcds.ui.Hud.showNotification("The tent stands " .. string.format("%.1f", height) .. " m tall.")
end

editorPreview.summary: Client only. A see-through preview of any of the game's own meshes or characters, not only the prop catalogue's, as an editor shows what it is about to place. Options as create, with `models` the game's mesh paths (objects/... .cgf, .cdf or .chr), up to 16. Returns null at the limit of 32.

params.options: `models`, the game's mesh paths, with `offsets` and `rotations`; `position`, required; `rotation`; `scale`; `tint`.

editorPreview.exampleLua:
-- client
local doorPreview = kcds.world.PropGhost.editorPreview({ models = { "objects/manmade/structures/doors/door_wood_a.cgf" }, position = kcds.players.LocalPlayer.position })
editorPreview.exampleCs:
// client
var doorPreview = PropGhost.EditorPreview(new { models = new[] { "objects/manmade/structures/doors/door_wood_a.cgf" }, position = LocalPlayer.Current!.Position });

create.summary: Client only. Puts a preview in this machine's world, with no body or collision, until the next level load. Nobody else sees it. Returns null at the limit of 32.

params.options: `model` or `models` from the prop catalogue, with `offsets` and `rotations`; `position`, required; `rotation`; `scale`, a number or per-axis Vector3; `tint`, a Color, translucent when `a` is below 1.

create.exampleLua:
-- client
local tentPreview = kcds.world.PropGhost.create({ model = "objects/manmade/structures/living/tents/canopy_forest_a.cgf", position = kcds.players.LocalPlayer.position })
tentPreview:setTint({ r = 0, g = 1, b = 0, a = 0.5 })

destroyAll.summary: Client only. Removes all ghosts this machine's scripts have drawn.
